result.summary: Overall the layout looks mostly clean, with only a minor visual inconsistency found in the promotional badge styling.

issues.description: The '-100%' discount badge on the pizza promo card is placed at the same position as the '€0 delivery' badge above it, but lacks consistent styling (color/shape) compared to the ramen bar's badge, creating slight visual inconsistency between similar promotional elements.
issues.suggestion: Standardize badge styling (color, padding, corner radius) across all promotional cards for visual consistency.
